message.content:
This document is a technical overview of Project Maya, a system for running large open-weight language models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) on consumer and prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Models and memory**
- Three model families with quantized variants (Maya-XS/S/M/L) sized from ~93 GB to ~470 GB; all run on NVIDIA V100/RTX 20+, AMD, and Windows.
- Quality is measured against originals: GLM-5.3 quants retain 97
